result.summary: A residential intersection with sidewalks but lacking marked crosswalks or pedestrian-specific infrastructure. The wide roadway and lack of crossing markings create exposure for pedestrians crossing between residential blocks.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The wide radius of the corners may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection on the right

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that completely lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or traffic control devices. Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass verges, creating a high-risk environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: The absence of dedicated pedestrian walkways forces people to walk in the street or on uneven grass, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway throughout the scene.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs, signals, or markings to regulate vehicle right-of-way or speed at the crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: At the junction of the two roads in the center of the image.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and ADA-compliant curb ramps to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or traffic calming measures like a mini-roundabout to manage vehicle speeds and clarify right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic control signs. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and potential sightline obstructions from mature trees create a higher-risk environment for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks or signage indicating a pedestrian crossing area at this intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large trees and parked vehicles near the corner may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs or pedestrian crossing warning signs to manage vehicle speeds and awareness.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked crosswalk and sidewalk, but significant visual obstructions from mature trees and bushes. The pavement on the side street is in poor condition, and there is a lack of visible traffic control or street lighting at the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large tree and dense bushes at the corner block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and degraded asphalt on the side street creates a potential trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and left side of the image

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove low-hanging branches and dense bushes at the corner to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the side street to provide a smooth, safe walking and driving surface.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add street light luminaires to existing utility poles or install new ones to improve nighttime visibility.
